title: Raku Firing Workshop
host_org: Watershed Center for the Ceramic Arts
source_quote:
Raku Firing
Dates
Saturday, October 10, 2026
Instructor
Matthew Dercole
Cost
$75
summary: Matthew Dercole leads a hands-on raku firing for Maine-based K–12 educators on October 10. Participants glaze bisqueware, observe and take part in a live firing, and learn how to incorporate raku into classroom instruction. No prior raku experience required; $75 includes firing and materials.
evidence_sentence: The workshop page describes a hands-on raku firing where participants glaze bisqueware and take part in a live firing.
evidence_quote: Join Studio & Facilities Manager, Matthew Dercole, as he leads a hands-on raku firing for Maine-based K–12 educators.
bring: Bisqueware of any clay body in a variety of shapes and sizes (please limit pieces over 10"), cotton clothing and closed toe shoes, safety goggles and leather gloves, packing material to transport work home
commitment: Saturday, 10/10, 8:45 AM check-in, 9 AM–5 PM instruction
how_to_join: Register via the link on the workshop page
